mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have fair conditions and a comfortable 70 degrees at Verona City Hall. If you are looking to the stars tonight, the International Space Station will be passing through, rising near Verona High School and traveling toward Fitchburg halfway up the sky.

City Hall is busy with election preparations. Candidate packets for the 2027 Spring Election are ready for pickup at 111 Lincoln Street, with a submission deadline of January 5. Also, please note that property tax bills will arrive by December 15, and payments can be made online, by mail, or at the 24/7 drop box.
Currently, there are no local events on the books for the next 30 days, giving us all a nice, quiet break in our local schedule.
On November 6, officers responded to a business on West Verona Avenue where they found a woman unresponsive in a vehicle, which resulted in an arrest for O W I after fire personnel gained access.
It is a great day to visit Culver's for their delicious Mint Cookie flavor of the day. They are open until 10:30 PM tonight, so you have plenty of time to stop by.
